title: Dual Exam: Controlled Evaluation of Multimodal Agents and World Models
title_zh: 双重考试：多模态智能体与世界模型的受控评估

paragraphs.en: World Models (WMs) can support Multimodal Agents (MAs) through simulated experience and action-conditioned predictions, while MA interaction trajectories can provide feedback for refining WMs. Assessing this potential relationship requires evidence about both components. A pilot study of one MA–WM pairing on 150 cases across ten scenarios illustrates why coupled outcomes alone are insufficient for diagnosing failure. We introduce Dual Exam, a framework that evaluates MAs under a fixed environment response mechanism and WMs under fixed action interventions. The Agent evaluation compares 10 configurations on 1,088 items in 15 reporting categories across physical, digital, social, and scientific domains. The World Model evaluation comprises 400 cases across eight scenarios, with 50 cases per scenario; 15 of 16 configurations cover all eight scenarios, and one covers six. GPT 6 Astra attains the highest Agent Index of 31.3 under the selected case-count weights, while GPT-Image-2 leads the full-coverage WM Overall scores at 21.7. These track-specific scores use different tasks and metrics and are not directly comparable. Agent strengths remain category-specific, and the aggregate ordering depends on the domain mixture. The evaluations characterize task-specific execution and state-transition performance. They provide a basis for studying reliable MA–WM interaction, while whether these capabilities predict coupled performance or sustained reciprocal improvement remains to be tested.
paragraphs.zh: 世界模型（World Models，WMs）可以通过模拟经验和以动作为条件的预测来支持多模态智能体（Multimodal Agents，MAs），而多模态智能体的交互轨迹也可以为世界模型的改进提供反馈。 评估这种潜在关系需要关于两个组成部分的证据。 对一个「多模态智能体–世界模型」配对在十个场景共 150 个案例上开展的初步研究，说明了为什么仅凭耦合结果不足以诊断失败原因。 我们提出 Dual Exam（双重考试），这是一个在固定环境响应机制下评估多模态智能体、并在固定动作干预下评估世界模型的框架。 智能体评估在物理、数字、社会和科学领域中，对 10 种配置在 15 个报告类别下的 1,088 个条目进行比较。 世界模型评估包含八个场景共 400 个案例，每个场景 50 个案例；16 种配置中有 15 种覆盖全部八个场景，另一种覆盖六个场景。 在所选案例数量权重下，GPT 6 Astra 以 31.3 的智能体指数位居最高，而 GPT-Image-2 以 21.7 领先于全覆盖世界模型总分。 这些针对特定赛道的评分使用了不同的任务和指标，因此不能直接比较。 智能体的优势仍局限于特定类别，总体排序取决于领域的组合方式。 这些评估刻画的是针对特定任务的执行性能和状态转移性能。 它们为研究可靠的多模态智能体–世界模型交互提供了基础，而这些能力能否预测耦合性能或持续的相互改进，仍有待检验。

paragraphs.en: World Models (WMs) and Multimodal Agents (MAs) can improve each other in complementary ways. WMs support MAs through simulated experience and action-conditioned predictions ( Ha & Schmidhuber, 2018 ; Hafner et al., 2025 ; Gu et al., 2025 ) , while MA interaction trajectories provide feedback for refining WMs ( Zhang et al., 2026b ; Yu et al., 2026 ) . Recent work has coupled the two in specific settings ( Fang et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . For example, a web agent can use a world model to anticipate candidate clicks, while its trajectories provide data for model refinement ( Fang et al., 2025 ) . Broader multimodal interaction requires both effective action selection and faithful responses to those actions. We assess these complementary requirements across physical, digital, social, and scientific domains ( Chu et al., 2026 ) . Our focus is task-specific component performance; the relationship between these measurements and gains from joint training requires separate validation.
paragraphs.zh: 世界模型（WM）与多模态智能体（MA）能够以互补的方式相互促进。 世界模型通过模拟经验和基于动作的条件预测为多模态智能体提供支持（Ha & Schmidhuber, 2018; Hafner et al., 2025; Gu et al., 2025），而多模态智能体的交互轨迹则为世界模型的改进提供反馈（Zhang et al., 2026b; Yu et al., 2026）。 近期的工作已在特定场景中将二者结合起来（Fang et al., 2025; Guo et al., 2025; Liu et al., 2026）。 例如，网页智能体可以利用世界模型预判候选点击，而其交互轨迹则为模型改进提供数据（Fang et al., 2025）。 更广泛的多模态交互既需要有效的动作选择，也需要对这些动作做出忠实的响应。 我们在物理、数字、社会和科学等领域评估这些互补性需求（Chu et al., 2026）。 我们关注的是任务特定的组件性能；这些测量结果与联合训练带来的收益之间的关系仍需另行验证。

sents.en: World Models (WMs) and Multimodal Agents (MAs) can improve each other in complementary ways.
sents.zh: 世界模型（WM）与多模态智能体（MA）能够以互补的方式相互促进。

sents.en: We assess these complementary requirements across physical, digital, social, and scientific domains ( Chu et al., 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: However, reciprocal improvement requires both MAs and WMs to remain reliable over repeated interaction. MAs still struggle with visual grounding, action sequencing, and sustained task completion ( Xie et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2026 ) . WMs also face challenges in memory consistency and action control ( Ye et al., 2026b ) . Visual fidelity or state similarity alone does not guarantee improved planning or successful task completion ( Shang et al., 2026a ; Huang et al., 2026 ) . These weaknesses become more apparent when MAs and WMs are coupled. The output of one repeatedly becomes the input to the other. WM-based simulation can improve planning ( Gu et al., 2025 ) , but the planning benefits depend on behavioral coverage, environment complexity, and whether the MA can use the predicted outcomes ( Li et al., 2025b ; Qian et al., 2026a ) . Model bias may also accumulate over repeated rollouts ( Janner et al., 2019 ) . End-to-end performance can show that the coupled system fails, but not why. Failures may come from MA decisions, WM responses, or their interaction. A component-level evaluation is therefore needed to characterize the capabilities that end-to-end outcomes alone cannot reveal.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，互惠改进要求智能体和世界模型在反复交互中保持可靠。 智能体在视觉定位、动作排序和持续任务完成方面仍存在困难（Xie et al., 2024；Chen et al., 2025；Sun et al., 2026）。 世界模型在记忆一致性和动作控制方面也面临挑战（Ye et al., 2026b）。 仅有视觉保真度或状态相似性并不能保证规划的改进或任务的成功完成（Shang et al., 2026a；Huang et al., 2026）。 当智能体与世界模型耦合时，这些弱点会变得更加明显。 一方的输出会反复成为另一方的输入。 基于世界模型的仿真可以改进规划（Gu et al., 2025），但规划收益取决于行为覆盖范围、环境复杂度，以及智能体能否利用预测结果（Li et al., 2025b；Qian et al., 2026a）。 模型偏差也可能在反复的滚动推演中不断累积（Janner et al., 2019）。 端到端性能只能表明耦合系统失败了，却无法说明失败的原因。 失败可能来自智能体的决策、世界模型的响应，或二者的交互。 因此，需要在组件层面进行评估，以刻画仅凭端到端结果无法揭示的能力。

sents.zh: 然而，互惠改进要求智能体和世界模型在反复交互中保持可靠。

paragraphs.en: Our preliminary study tests one MA–WM pairing on 150 cases across ten scenarios, with 0% task success under the stated protocol (Section 2.1 ). The trajectories reveal state discrepancies and limited responses, but do not identify which component caused each failure. This motivates Dual Exam : controlled, separate assessments of MAs and WMs rather than causal attribution from coupled outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的初步研究在一个元智能体–工作记忆配对上，跨十个场景测试了150个案例，在所述协议（第2.1节）下任务成功率为0%。 这些轨迹揭示了状态不一致和响应有限的情况，但无法识别是哪个组件导致了每次失败。 这促使我们提出双重考试：对智能体和工作记忆进行受控的、分离的评估，而不是从耦合的结果中进行因果归因。

paragraphs.en: Selected frames: 1 ⋯ 3 ⋯ 6 ⋯ 8 ⋯ 12 ⋯ 14 1\;\cdots\;3\;\cdots\;6\;\cdots\;8\;\cdots\;12\;\cdots\;14 (nonconsecutive).

We instantiate Dual Exam across four representative domains: physical, digital, social, and scientific. The two tracks share specification-based verification, assessing recorded evidence against explicit goals and state constraints while retaining track-specific cases and metrics. The Agent evaluation compares 10 configurations on 1,088 items organized into 15 reporting categories. The World Model evaluation contains 400 cases across eight scenarios, with 50 cases per scenario and configuration-specific coverage reported in the results. GPT 6 Astra attains the highest Agent Index of 31.3 under the configured case-count weights. GPT-Image-2 leads the full-coverage WM Overall scores at 21.7; 15 of the 16 WM configurations cover all eight scenarios, while Seedance 2.5 is reported separately on six. Performance varies substantially across task categories, and illustrative trajectories distinguish locally plausible behavior from satisfaction of complete task requirements. These measurements characterize the evaluated model–harness configurations under their recorded task specifications; execution settings are not fully matched across configurations. Whether their profiles predict coupled success or improvement through joint training remains an empirical question.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在物理、数字、社会和科学四个代表性领域中实例化「双重考试」。 两条赛道共享基于规范的验证方式，即依据明确的目标和状态约束评估记录的证据，同时保留各自赛道专属的案例和指标。 智能体评估在 1,088 个条目上比较 10 种配置，这些条目被组织为 15 个报告类别。 世界模型评估包含横跨八个场景的 400 个案例，每个场景 50 个案例，并在结果中报告各配置的具体覆盖情况。 GPT 6 Astra 在所配置的案例数量权重下取得最高的智能体指数 31.3。 GPT-Image-2 以 21.7 领先全覆盖的世界模型总分；16 个世界模型配置中有 15 个覆盖全部八个场景，而 Seedance 2.5 则在六个场景上被单独报告。 性能在各任务类别间差异显著，示例性轨迹区分了局部上看似合理的行为与完整任务要求的达成。 这些测量结果刻画了各被评估的模型—框架配置在其记录的任务规范下的表现；各配置的执行设置并未完全匹配。 它们的表现特征能否预测通过联合训练实现的耦合成功或改进，仍是一个经验性问题。

paragraphs.en: We introduce Dual Exam , a framework for separate, controlled evaluation of Multimodal Agents and World Models. Both tracks verify recorded evidence against task specifications, using fixed environment response mechanisms for Agents and fixed interventions for World Models.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Dual Exam，一个用于对多模态智能体与世界模型进行分离式、可控评估的框架。 两条评估路径均依据任务规范核验所记录的证据，对智能体使用固定的环境响应机制，对世界模型使用固定的干预手段。

sents.zh: 我们提出 Dual Exam，一个用于对多模态智能体与世界模型进行分离式、可控评估的框架。

paragraphs.en: We compare 10 Agent configurations on 1,088 items in 15 reporting categories across four domains, and organize the World Model evaluation into 400 cases across eight scenarios. The results provide complementary task and scenario profiles, with explicit aggregation rules and configuration-specific coverage.

We first present a preliminary study of coupled MA–WM interaction to motivate the design of Dual Exam. The framework evaluates Agents under fixed reference environment responses and World Models under fixed action interventions. Both tracks assess task-relevant behavior against specified goals and constraints, while retaining track-specific cases, interaction protocols, and verification procedures. The two tracks need not use one-to-one matched episodes. Evaluation relies on recorded execution evidence rather than self-reported completion. Across physical, digital, social, and scientific domains, Dual Exam comprises 1,088 Agent evaluation items and 400 World Model cases.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先对耦合的智能体–世界模型交互进行初步研究，以引出 Dual Exam 的设计动机。 该框架在固定参考环境响应下评估智能体，并在固定动作干预下评估世界模型。 两条评估线均依据指定目标与约束来评估与任务相关的行为，同时保留各自特有的案例、交互协议和验证流程。 两条评估线无需使用一一对应的回合。 评估依赖记录的执行证据，而非自我报告的完成情况。 在物理、数字、社会和科学领域，Dual Exam 共包含 1,088 个智能体评估项和 400 个世界模型案例。

paragraphs.en: The packing rollout illustrates the gap between issuing task commands and meeting task requirements (Figure 2 (b)). paragraphs.en: The pilot motivates a diagnostic question: how does each component perform when the other side is controlled? Dual Exam holds a fixed reference environment response mechanism fixed to test MAs and fixes action interventions to test WMs against specified goals and constraints (Figure 2 (c)). These tests measure role-specific performance rather than retrospectively assigning causes to the pilot failures. Table 2 compares this scope with existing benchmarks.

paragraphs.en: Notation. ✓ / ✗ indicate explicit / no explicit coverage, not model capability; coverage need not span all tasks. Multimodal Input : visual inputs paired with language or action/control inputs, initially or during interaction. Interactive Rollout : actions or controls affect subsequent observations or states, using predefined or adaptive sequences. Environment-grounded : evaluation against execution outcomes or independently verifiable environment states. Component Isolation : controlled reference conditions or interventions evaluate one component while fixing the other side. This indicates evaluation design, not causal attribution of failures in a coupled system. Persistent State : dedicated evaluation of state preservation or evolution across revisits, occlusion, or interaction turns, beyond generic temporal video quality. Four-domain Coverage : coverage of physical, digital, social, and scientific domains. # Eval. Units : benchmark-specific counts of questions, tasks, prompts, videos, or scenarios, not directly comparable.
paragraphs.zh: 记号说明。✓ / ✗ 表示有明确 / 无明确覆盖，而非模型能力；覆盖无需涵盖所有任务。 多模态输入：视觉输入与语言或动作/控制输入成对出现，无论是在初始阶段还是在交互过程中。 交互式推演：动作或控制会影响后续的观察或状态，使用预定义或自适应的序列。 环境锚定：基于执行结果或可独立验证的环境状态进行评估。 组件隔离：通过受控的参照条件或干预来评估其中一个组件，同时固定另一侧。 这表明的是评估设计，而非对耦合系统中失败的因果归因。 持久状态：对状态在重访、遮挡或交互轮次之间的保持或演化的专门评估，超出一般的时间性视频质量范畴。 四域覆盖：对物理、数字、社交和科学领域的覆盖。# 评估。 计量单位：各基准所特定的问题、任务、提示、视频或场景的数量，不可直接比较。

paragraphs.en: We ask (RQ1) how Agent task performance varies when the response mechanism is fixed, and (RQ2) how World Models realize prescribed actions while preserving task-relevant state. The pilot motivates these questions; it is not a third, matched factorial experiment. Our four domains provide diverse operational settings, not a complete or orthogonal taxonomy of intelligence. The reporting categories organize tasks and results rather than define independent latent abilities; each task is scored against verifiable outcomes and constraints. The full inventory appears in Table 5 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出两个研究问题：（RQ1）当响应机制固定时，智能体任务表现如何变化；（RQ2）世界模型在执行规定动作的同时，如何保持与任务相关的状态。 该先导实验引出了这些问题，但它并不是第三项匹配的因子实验。 我们的四个领域提供了多样的操作环境，并非一个完整或正交的智能分类体系。 这些报告类别用于组织任务与结果，而非定义独立的潜在能力；每项任务都根据可验证的结果和约束条件进行评分。 完整清单见表5。

paragraphs.en: Reliable MA–WM interaction requires both effective action selection and faithful action-conditioned state evolution. An Agent must choose actions that advance the task, while a WM must realize their consequences and preserve task-relevant state. These requirements are interdependent in coupled rollouts: WM outputs inform subsequent MA decisions, and MA actions determine the transitions the WM must generate. End-to-end outcomes therefore reflect both components and their interaction. Dual Exam examines these complementary requirements through two controlled evaluation tracks. The Agent track fixes the environment response mechanism to assess action selection and task completion, while the World Model track fixes action interventions to assess the resulting state evolution. Together, the tracks characterize capability gaps on both sides of the interaction loop. Specifically, the Agent track evaluates a candidate A θ A_{\theta} against a fixed reference environment response process:
paragraphs.zh: 可靠的MA–WM交互既需要有效的动作选择，也需要忠实的动作条件化状态演化。 智能体必须选择能推进任务的动作，而世界模型必须实现这些动作的后果并保留与任务相关的状态。 这些要求在耦合的推演中相互依存：世界模型的输出为智能体的后续决策提供信息，而智能体的动作决定了世界模型必须生成的状态转移。 因此，端到端的结果同时反映了这两个组件及其交互。 Dual Exam 通过两条受控的评估轨道来考察这些互补的要求。 智能体轨道固定环境响应机制以评估动作选择与任务完成，而世界模型轨道固定动作干预以评估由此产生的状态演化。 两条轨道共同刻画了交互回路两侧的能力缺口。 具体而言，智能体轨道在固定的参考环境响应过程下评估候选智能体 A_{\theta}：

sents.zh: 可靠的MA–WM交互既需要有效的动作选择，也需要忠实的动作条件化状态演化。

sents.en: An Agent must choose actions that advance the task, while a WM must realize their consequences and preserve task-relevant state.
sents.zh: 智能体必须选择能推进任务的动作，而世界模型必须实现这些动作的后果并保留与任务相关的状态。

sents.en: These requirements are interdependent in coupled rollouts: WM outputs inform subsequent MA decisions, and MA actions determine the transitions the WM must generate.
sents.zh: 这些要求在耦合的推演中相互依存：世界模型的输出为智能体的后续决策提供信息，而智能体的动作决定了世界模型必须生成的状态转移。

sents.en: End-to-end outcomes therefore reflect both components and their interaction.
sents.zh: 因此，端到端的结果同时反映了这两个组件及其交互。

sents.en: Dual Exam examines these complementary requirements through two controlled evaluation tracks.
sents.zh: Dual Exam 通过两条受控的评估轨道来考察这些互补的要求。

sents.en: The Agent track fixes the environment response mechanism to assess action selection and task completion, while the World Model track fixes action interventions to assess the resulting state evolution.
sents.zh: 智能体轨道固定环境响应机制以评估动作选择与任务完成，而世界模型轨道固定动作干预以评估由此产生的状态演化。

sents.en: Together, the tracks characterize capability gaps on both sides of the interaction loop.
sents.zh: 两条轨道共同刻画了交互回路两侧的能力缺口。

paragraphs.en: Both tracks specify an initial condition, permitted intervention, required change, protected state, and evidence rule. For example, a specification can require moving an object into a particular container while preserving that container’s identity. In an Agent test, the reference environment executes the Agent’s chosen actions and the verifier checks the goal. In a WM test, a prescribed packing action is supplied and generated observations are checked for the requested change and preserved identity. This example explains how the same invariant can be expressed in both tracks; it does not report a matched pair of evaluated episodes. Shared specification principles do not imply shared tasks, numerical scores, or training data.
paragraphs.zh: 两条轨道均规定了初始条件、允许的干预、所需的变化、受保护的状态以及证据规则。 例如，规范可以要求将一个物体移动到特定容器中，同时保持该容器的身份不变。 在智能体测试中，参考环境执行智能体选择的动作，验证器检查目标是否达成。 在WM测试中，提供规定的打包动作，并检查生成的观测结果是否满足所要求的变化和被保持的身份。 这个例子说明了同一个不变量如何在两条轨道中都能被表达；它并未报告一对匹配的已评估情节。 共享的规范原则并不意味着共享任务、数值评分或训练数据。

They do not by themselves establish the cause of a particular coupled failure or whether joint training will yield sustained reciprocal improvement. These questions require matched interaction experiments and evaluation across successive training rounds.

paragraphs.en: Benchmark construction. The current Agent inventory contains 1,088 evaluation tasks in 15 reporting categories across four domains: 524 Physical, 255 Digital, 200 Social, and 109 Scientific. The Scientific domain combines 63 selected tasks from Agents’ Last Exam (ALE), 30 scientific code-repair tasks sourced from SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al., 2023 ) , ten ToolChoice tasks derived from the repair workflows, and six EdgeBench optimization tasks ( Zhu et al., 2026a ) . Each ToolChoice task inherits its parent repair task’s subject category but constitutes a distinct evaluated decision checkpoint. The 109 tasks therefore include 99 full workflows and ten checkpoints; their related provenance does not imply independent observations. Six EdgeBench optimization tasks are included; the other 84 historical ALE tasks remain excluded. Table 5 gives the category counts, while Table 10 separates subject category from task source.
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试构建。 当前的智能体清单包含 1,088 个评估任务，分为四个领域的 15 个报告类别：物理领域 524 个、数字领域 255 个、社会领域 200 个、科学领域 109 个。 科学领域合并了从 Agents' Last Exam（ALE）中选取的 63 个任务、来自 SWE-bench（Jimenez et al., 2023）的 30 个科学代码修复任务、由修复工作流派生的十个 ToolChoice 任务，以及六个 EdgeBench 优化任务（Zhu et al., 2026a）。 每个 ToolChoice 任务继承其父级修复任务的主题类别，但构成一个独立的被评估决策检查点。 因此，这 109 个任务包括 99 个完整工作流和十个检查点；它们的相关来源并不意味着是独立的观测。 其中包含六个 EdgeBench 优化任务；其余 84 个历史 ALE 任务仍被排除在外。 表 5 给出了各类别的数量，而表 10 则将主题类别与任务来源区分开来。

paragraphs.en: Benchmark construction. The World Model evaluation comprises 400 cases across eight scenarios, with 50 cases per scenario: Embodiment, Driving, and Daily Life in the Physical domain; Web and Game in the Digital domain; Human Interaction in the Social domain; and Natural Science and Expert Science in the Scientific domain. Cases specify interventions and checks for requested action effects, preservation of prior state and identities, shared-state consistency, and rule adherence. This allocation gives 150 Physical, 100 Digital, 50 Social, and 100 Scientific cases. Case construction and validation are distinct from independent verification of scores assigned to model outputs.
paragraphs.zh: 基准构建。 世界模型评估包含八个场景共400个案例，每个场景50个案例：物理领域包括具身、驾驶和日常生活；数字领域包括网页和游戏；社会领域包括人际交互；科学领域包括自然科学和专家科学。 案例规定了干预和检查，用于验证所请求动作的效果、先前状态与身份的保持、共享状态的一致性以及规则的遵守。 这种分配得到物理领域150个、数字领域100个、社会领域50个和科学领域100个案例。 案例的构建与验证不同于对分配给模型输出的评分进行的独立核验。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation and aggregation. Each rollout uses fixed interventions and the observations and history permitted by its configuration. Case-specific checks assess action effects, state and identity preservation, shared-state consistency, and rule adherence. Observable model errors remain evaluation outcomes; technical failures and unsupported scenarios must be recorded separately. WM Overall is the mean of the eight scenario scores on a 0–100 scale. With 50 cases per scenario, this is also a case-balanced aggregate when each scenario score averages the same number of equally weighted case scores. It is not an equal-domain average: the scenario allocation gives Physical, Digital, Social, and Scientific weights of 37.5%, 25%, 12.5%, and 25%. Missing scenario scores are not zeros. A mean over fewer scenarios must be labeled as partial coverage and must not enter the full-coverage Overall ranking.
paragraphs.zh: 评估与聚合。 每次 rollout 使用固定的干预措施，以及其配置所允许的观测和历史记录。 针对具体案例的检查评估动作效果、状态与身份保持、共享状态一致性以及规则遵守情况。 可观察的模型错误仍属于评估结果；技术故障和不受支持的场景必须单独记录。 WM Overall 是八个场景得分在 0–100 分制上的平均值。 在每个场景包含 50 个案例的情况下，当每个场景得分对相同数量的等权重案例得分取平均时，它也是一个案例均衡的聚合值。 它不是等领域的平均值：场景分配赋予 Physical、Digital、Social 和 Scientific 的权重分别为 37.5%、25%、12.5% 和 25%。 缺失的场景得分不计为零。 在较少场景上取得的平均值必须标注为部分覆盖，并且不得进入全覆盖 Overall 排名。

paragraphs.en: Following the coupled pilot, we evaluate the two components separately. Table 3 compares 10 Agent configurations across 15 reporting categories and 1,088 evaluation items. The World Model evaluation uses 400 cases across eight scenarios, with 50 cases per scenario; Table 4 reports scenario scores and distinguishes full from partial coverage. Agent Index and WM Overall use different tasks, metrics, and aggregation rules and are not directly comparable. Appendices A and B provide illustrative trajectories. These examples explain particular behaviors rather than estimate failure frequencies or establish controlled comparisons between historical configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 在耦合试点之后，我们对两个组成部分分别进行评估。 表 3 在 15 个报告类别和 1,088 个评估项上比较了 10 种智能体配置。 世界模型评估使用 8 个场景共 400 个案例，每个场景 50 个案例；表 4 报告各场景得分，并区分完全覆盖与部分覆盖。 智能体指数与世界模型总分使用不同的任务、指标和聚合规则，因此不能直接比较。 附录 A 和附录 B 提供示例性轨迹。 这些例子用于解释特定行为，而非估计失败频率或在历史配置之间建立受控比较。

paragraphs.en: The fixed-environment track measures Agent performance without variation from a candidate World Model. The highest displayed scores are 9.5 for Manipulation, 11.2 for Action Sequencing, and 5.6 for Desktop Application Interaction. Other settings yield higher maxima: 29.6 for Web Interaction, 42.9 for Mobile Application Interaction, and 47.1 for Game Environment Interaction. These contrasts describe performance under the respective task requirements and scoring rules; they do not isolate the effect of the interaction setting or establish equal difficulty across categories. The results nevertheless show that a high aggregate score can coexist with low scores on particular execution tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 固定环境轨道在不引入候选世界模型变异的情况下测量智能体的性能。 显示的最高分数为：操作 9.5，动作序列 11.2，桌面应用交互 5.6。 其他设置产生更高的最大值：网页交互 29.6，移动应用交互 42.9，游戏环境交互 47.1。 这些对比描述的是在各自任务要求和评分规则下的表现；它们并未隔离交互设置的影响，也无法确立各类别之间难度相等。 然而，这些结果表明，较高的总分可能与某些特定执行任务上的低分并存。

paragraphs.en: The illustrative Navigation cases distinguish valid feasibility judgments from routes containing nonexistent edges. The Action Sequencing cases similarly distinguish correct clip membership from correct ordering. In each setting, recognizing relevant elements is insufficient when their combination violates the task’s constraints. These examples motivate explicit checks of route validity, ordering, and goal satisfaction during execution. They illustrate possible failure mechanisms but do not establish their frequency in the current evaluation or their causal contribution to model rankings.
paragraphs.zh: 该导航（Navigation）示例用例区分了有效的可行性判断与包含不存在边的路线。 动作排序（Action Sequencing）示例用例同样区分了正确的片段归属与正确的排序。 在每种设置中，仅识别相关元素是不够的，因为它们的组合可能违反任务约束。 这些示例说明在执行过程中需要对路线有效性、排序和目标达成进行显式检查。 它们展示了可能的失败机制，但并未确立这些机制在当前评估中出现的频率，也未确立其对模型排名的因果贡献。

paragraphs.en: Across 109 Scientific items, GPT 6 Astra has the highest within-domain case-weighted score of 50.6, followed by DeepSeek V4.1 Flash at 44.0 and GPT 5.6 Sol at 42.2. The category leaders differ: Astra leads Mathematics & Computation (60.8) and Physical Sciences (52.2), Sol leads Health & Medicine (45.4), and DeepSeek leads Life Sciences (53.7). These scores combine 63 ALE tasks, 30 SWE-bench repair tasks, ten derived ToolChoice checkpoints, and six EdgeBench optimization tasks. SWE and ToolChoice contribute strict binary outcomes, while Edge contributes graded quality scores under the mapping in Appendix A.13 , including our explicit clipping convention for Borden and DABIC. The domain mean is therefore not a uniform success rate, and the related ToolChoice checkpoints do not constitute independent full-workflow trials.
paragraphs.zh: 在109个科学类项目中，GPT 6 Astra 以50.6的域内按案例加权得分排名第一，其次是 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash（44.0）和 GPT 5.6 Sol（42.2）。 各类别的领先者有所不同：Astra 领先于数学与计算（60.8）和物理科学（52.2），Sol 领先于健康与医学（45.4），DeepSeek 领先于生命科学（53.7）。 这些得分综合了63个 ALE 任务、30个 SWE-bench 修复任务、十个派生的 ToolChoice 检查点以及六个 EdgeBench 优化任务。 SWE 和 ToolChoice 贡献严格的二元结果，而 Edge 按附录 A.13 中的映射贡献分级质量得分，包括我们对 Borden 和 DABIC 的显式截断约定。 因此，该领域均值并非统一的成功率，相关的 ToolChoice 检查点也不构成独立的完整工作流试验。

paragraphs.en: GPT 6 Astra leads the case-weighted Agent Index with 31.3, followed by GPT 5.6 Sol at 20.7 and Gemini 3.6 Flash at 20.1. Qwen 3.8 Max ranks fourth at 20.0 and Kimi K3 fifth at 19.8. Four configurations attain the highest displayed score in at least one category: GPT 6 Astra leads nine categories, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash leads three, GPT 5.6 Sol leads two, and Seed 2.1 Pro leads one. No configuration leads every category. Equal-domain weighting changes several positions: DeepSeek moves from sixth to second and Kimi from fifth to fourth, while GPT 6 Astra remains first (Appendix A.2 ). Physical tasks account for 48.16% of Index and Scientific tasks for 10.02%; these weights reflect the inventory rather than equal domain importance. These rankings describe the chosen aggregation rules and evaluated model–harness configurations. Small differences derived from rounded baseline means do not establish statistically significant superiority.
paragraphs.zh: GPT 6 Astra 以 31.3 分在按案例加权的智能体指数中领先，GPT 5.6 Sol 以 20.7 分位居第二，Gemini 3.6 Flash 以 20.1 分位居第三。 Qwen 3.8 Max 以 20.0 分排名第四，Kimi K3 以 19.8 分排名第五。 有四个配置至少在一个类别中取得最高显示分数：GPT 6 Astra 在九个类别中领先，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 在三个类别中领先，GPT 5.6 Sol 在两个类别中领先，Seed 2.1 Pro 在一个类别中领先。 没有任何配置在所有类别中均领先。 等域加权改变了多个位置：DeepSeek 从第六升至第二，Kimi 从第五升至第四，而 GPT 6 Astra 保持第一（附录 A.2）。 物理任务占指数的 48.16%，科学任务占 10.02%；这些权重反映的是任务清单情况，而非各领域同等的重要性。 这些排名描述的是所选的聚合规则以及被评估的模型—执行框架配置。 由四舍五入的基线均值产生的微小差异并不能证明具有统计学显著性的优越性。

paragraphs.en: Category names describe reporting groups, not independent latent abilities. Physical Sciences includes physics, chemistry, materials, and Earth/space applications. Game Environment Interaction includes Godot and GameWorld without double counting. The bars show Index on a shared zero-based 0–35 axis with a light reference at 20; the score range remains 0–100. A light purple-to-orange palette follows the displayed model order; color differences do not indicate statistical significance. Six EdgeBench optimization tasks are included using the convention in Appendix A.13 . Scientific scores combine the original ALE category means with 30 SWE-bench repair tasks, ten ToolChoice tasks, and six EdgeBench tasks. paragraphs.en: The fixed-intervention track tests whether valid action inputs produce valid state evolution. Its illustrative failures show that responding to the current instruction is only part of this requirement. Qwen-Image-3.0 restores the apparatus view following an instruction in the pendulum case (Appendix Figure 21 ), but introduces additional cups in the cup-stacking case, violating the initial quantity constraint (Appendix Figure 23 ). MiniMax H3 preserves the cup count yet introduces an unrequested red tray, whereas GPT-Image-2 preserves the original tray colors (Appendix Figure 24 ). These cases illustrate distinct failures in realizing requested changes and preserving unaffected state; they do not establish the causes of aggregate ranking differences. In coupled interaction, such state errors can become misleading observations for the Agent.
paragraphs.zh: 固定干预轨道测试有效的动作输入能否产生有效的状态演化。 其示例性失败表明，响应当前指令只是这一要求的一部分。 Qwen-Image-3.0 在钟摆案例中按照指令恢复了装置视图（附录图 21），但在叠杯案例中引入了额外的杯子，违反了初始数量约束（附录图 23）。 MiniMax H3 保持了杯子数量，却引入了一个未被要求的红色托盘，而 GPT-Image-2 保持了原有的托盘颜色（附录图 24）。 这些案例展示了在实现所请求的变更和保持未受影响状态方面的不同失败；它们并未确立总体排名差异的原因。 在耦合交互中，此类状态错误可能成为对智能体具有误导性的观察结果。

paragraphs.en: All evaluated configurations score at most 16.5 on Web and 13.3 on Game (Table 4 ). Even models with stronger results elsewhere remain weak in these scenarios: MiniMax H3 scores 53.8 on Embodiment but only 3.7 on Web and 8.5 on Game, while Qwen-Image-3.0 scores 46.1 on Daily Life but 10.7 on Web and 11.5 on Game. These results identify digital scenarios as a shared weakness under the evaluated protocol, although differences in task difficulty and scoring prevent attributing the gap solely to the domain.
paragraphs.zh: 所有被评估的配置在 Web 上最多得 16.5 分，在 Game 上最多得 13.3 分（表 4）。 即使在其他方面表现更强的模型，在这些场景中依然较弱：MiniMax H3 在 Embodiment 上得 53.8 分，但在 Web 上仅得 3.7 分，在 Game 上仅得 8.5 分；而 Qwen-Image-3.0 在 Daily Life 上得 46.1 分，但在 Web 上仅得 10.7 分，在 Game 上仅得 11.5 分。 这些结果表明，在所评估的协议下，数字场景是一个共同的弱点，但由于任务难度和评分方式的差异，无法将这一差距仅仅归因于该领域。

paragraphs.en: GPT-Image-2 leads WM Overall with 21.7 versus 17.3 for MiniMax H3, but their ordering reverses on Embodiment, at 20.9 versus 53.8. WM Overall weights the eight scenarios equally, whereas a particular Agent may encounter a different distribution of states and actions. A higher overall score therefore need not imply more reliable responses along that Agent’s trajectories. Scenario profiles narrow this uncertainty, but selecting an effective Agent–World Model pairing requires evaluation on the interactions the pair actually produces.
paragraphs.zh: GPT-Image-2 在 WM 总体上以 21.7 领先 MiniMax H3 的 17.3，但在具身（Embodiment）上二者的排序反转，为 20.9 对 53.8。 WM 总体分数对八个场景等权平均，而某个特定智能体可能遇到不同分布的状态与动作。 因此，更高的总体分数并不一定意味着在该智能体的轨迹上响应更可靠。 场景画像可以缩小这种不确定性，但选择有效的智能体—世界模型配对，仍需在这一配对实际产生的交互上进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Reliable task progress requires both effective Agent decisions and World Model responses that correctly realize action effects while preserving task-relevant state, since these responses also inform the Agent’s judgment of progress. The two tracks assess these complementary capabilities, but do not establish how their scores jointly predict coupled success.
paragraphs.zh: 可靠的任务进展既需要智能体做出有效决策，也需要世界模型的响应在正确实现动作效果的同时保留与任务相关的状态，因为这些响应还会影响智能体对进展的判断。 这两条赛道考察的是这些互补能力，但并未说明二者的分数如何共同预测耦合的成功。

paragraphs.en: Existing benchmarks typically assess one component. Agent benchmarks measure tool use, collaboration, workplace execution, transferable skills, and long-horizon computer operation ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Yao et al., 2024 ; Barres et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ) , whereas World Model benchmarks evaluate prediction, embodied functionality, latent dynamics, memory, action control, and behavioral consistency ( Shang et al., 2026b ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Vafa et al., 2024 ; Ye et al., 2026b ; Huang et al., 2026 ) . These benchmarks assess competence, not reciprocal improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 现有基准通常只评估单个组件。 智能体基准衡量工具使用、协作、职场执行、可迁移技能以及长时程计算机操作（Liu et al., 2024; Yao et al., 2024; Barres et al., 2025; Xu et al., 2024; Li et al., 2026; Sun et al., 2026），而世界模型基准则评估预测、具身功能、潜在动力学、记忆、动作控制和行为一致性（Shang et al., 2026b; Chen et al., 2025; Vafa et al., 2024; Ye et al., 2026b; Huang et al., 2026）。 这些基准评估的是能力，而非相互提升。

paragraphs.en: Prior work supports both directions. Dyna and learned World Models use simulated trajectories to improve planning and policies ( Sutton, 1990 ; Ha & Schmidhuber, 2018 ; Hafner et al., 2025 ; Gu et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . Conversely, Agent-directed exploration and policy rollouts improve held-out World Model learning or adapt simulators ( Kim et al., 2020 ; Chebotar et al., 2019 ) , while recent methods refine World Models from interaction feedback ( Zhang et al., 2026b ; Yu et al., 2026 ) . DreamZero jointly predicts video and actions for robot control and reports transfer to new tasks and embodiments ( Ye et al., 2026a ) . Such results support studying action-conditioned visual models in embodied systems; they do not validate our cross-domain rankings or establish a reciprocal training loop. These gains are demonstrated within bounded task distributions. Narrow-domain systems begin to close the loop. WebEvolver ( Fang et al., 2025 ) couples Agent experience with an evolving World Model, GenEnv co-evolves LLM Agents and environment simulators, and COMAP alternates World Model and policy updates ( Fang et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 已有工作支持这两个方向。 Dyna 和学习式世界模型利用模拟轨迹来改进规划与策略（Sutton, 1990；Ha & Schmidhuber, 2018；Hafner et al., 2025；Gu et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2026）。 反过来，智能体引导的探索与策略推演可以改进留出的世界模型学习或自适应模拟器（Kim et al., 2020；Chebotar et al., 2019），而近期方法则从交互反馈中精炼世界模型（Zhang et al., 2026b；Yu et al., 2026）。 DreamZero 联合预测视频与动作以实现机器人控制，并报告了向新任务和新本体的迁移（Ye et al., 2026a）。 这些结果支持在具身系统中研究动作条件下的视觉模型；它们并不能验证我们的跨领域排名，也无法建立双向的训练闭环。 这些增益是在有限的任务分布内得到验证的。 窄领域系统开始闭合这一循环。 WebEvolver（Fang et al., 2025）将智能体经验与不断演进的世界模型相结合，GenEnv 让 LLM 智能体与环境模拟器协同演化，COMAP 则交替进行世界模型与策略的更新（Fang et al., 2025；Guo et al., 2025；Liu et al., 2026）。

sents.en: Prior work supports both directions.
sents.zh: 已有工作支持这两个方向。

sents.zh: 反过来，智能体引导的探索与策略推演可以改进留出的世界模型学习或自适应模拟器（Kim et al., 2020；Chebotar et al., 2019），而近期方法则从交互反馈中精炼世界模型（Zhang et al., 2026b；Yu et al., 2026）。

sents.en: DreamZero jointly predicts video and actions for robot control and reports transfer to new tasks and embodiments ( Ye et al., 2026a ) .
sents.zh: DreamZero 联合预测视频与动作以实现机器人控制，并报告了向新任务和新本体的迁移（Ye et al., 2026a）。

sents.en: Such results support studying action-conditioned visual models in embodied systems; they do not validate our cross-domain rankings or establish a reciprocal training loop.
sents.zh: 这些结果支持在具身系统中研究动作条件下的视觉模型；它们并不能验证我们的跨领域排名，也无法建立双向的训练闭环。

sents.en: These gains are demonstrated within bounded task distributions.
sents.zh: 这些增益是在有限的任务分布内得到验证的。

sents.en: Narrow-domain systems begin to close the loop.
sents.zh: 窄领域系统开始闭合这一循环。

sents.en: WebEvolver ( Fang et al., 2025 ) couples Agent experience with an evolving World Model, GenEnv co-evolves LLM Agents and environment simulators, and COMAP alternates World Model and policy updates ( Fang et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: WebEvolver（Fang et al., 2025）将智能体经验与不断演进的世界模型相结合，GenEnv 让 LLM 智能体与环境模拟器协同演化，COMAP 则交替进行世界模型与策略的更新（Fang et al., 2025；Guo et al., 2025；Liu et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: World Models can improve Agents through simulated experience, as DreamerV3 demonstrates across diverse control tasks ( Hafner et al., 2025 ) . Such benefits depend on controlling model bias: MBPO uses short simulated rollouts to support policy learning ( Janner et al., 2019 ) . The relevant test is whether this experience improves Agent behavior beyond the model used for training.
paragraphs.zh: 世界模型可以通过模拟经验来改进智能体，正如 DreamerV3 在多种控制任务中所展示的那样（Hafner et al., 2025）。 这些收益取决于对模型偏差的控制：MBPO 使用较短的模拟轨迹来支持策略学习（Janner et al., 2019）。 相关的检验标准是，这种经验能否在训练所用模型之外改进智能体的行为。

sents.en: World Models can improve Agents through simulated experience, as DreamerV3 demonstrates across diverse control tasks ( Hafner et al., 2025 ) .

paragraphs.en: Agents can, in turn, improve World Models by collecting informative interaction data. Directed exploration improves predictive model learning ( Kim et al., 2020 ) , while SimOpt uses real policy rollouts to refine simulator parameter distributions and improve policy transfer ( Chebotar et al., 2019 ) . These updates improve the model or simulator; the Agent’s task score alone does not measure the collected data’s training value.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体反过来可以通过收集有信息量的交互数据来改进世界模型。 有向探索可以改进预测模型的学习（Kim et al., 2020），而SimOpt利用真实策略滚动来细化模拟器参数分布并改进策略迁移（Chebotar et al., 2019）。 这些更新改进的是模型或模拟器；仅凭智能体的任务分数并不能衡量所收集数据的训练价值。

sents.en: Agents can, in turn, improve World Models by collecting informative interaction data.
sents.zh: 智能体反过来可以通过收集有信息量的交互数据来改进世界模型。

sents.en: Directed exploration improves predictive model learning ( Kim et al., 2020 ) , while SimOpt uses real policy rollouts to refine simulator parameter distributions and improve policy transfer ( Chebotar et al., 2019 ) .
sents.zh: 有向探索可以改进预测模型的学习（Kim et al., 2020），而SimOpt利用真实策略滚动来细化模拟器参数分布并改进策略迁移（Chebotar et al., 2019）。

sents.zh: 这些更新改进的是模型或模拟器；仅凭智能体的任务分数并不能衡量所收集数据的训练价值。

paragraphs.en: Connecting these directions offers a route to co-evolution, but separate gains do not establish a stable loop. WebEvolver links them by training a World Model on Agent trajectories and using it for policy training and look-ahead planning ( Fang et al., 2025 ) . We hypothesize that reciprocal improvement across broader multimodal tasks may become sustainable once both components reach sufficient task-specific competence, but neither this transition nor the required capability levels has been established.
paragraphs.zh: 将这些方向联系起来为共同进化提供了一条路径，但各自单独的收益并不能构成一个稳定的循环。 WebEvolver 通过在智能体轨迹上训练一个世界模型，并将其用于策略训练和前瞻规划，将二者联系起来（Fang et al., 2025）。 我们假设，一旦两个组成部分都达到足够的任务专项能力，更广泛的多模态任务上的相互提升可能会变得可持续，但这一转变以及所需的能力水平均尚未得到证实。

paragraphs.en: Dual Exam diagnoses component capabilities rather than co-evolution itself. Our observed execution and state-consistency failures identify possible obstacles to useful interaction, not evidence of limited learnability. In the packing case, commands continue after the container changes (Figure 2 ); this observation motivates diagnosis but does not test whether either component can learn from the interaction. Future work should compare joint updates with Agent-only, World-Model-only, and no-update controls, using fixed held-out tests across rounds and seeds to track both components and closed-loop task success. This would test whether both components improve over successive rounds and whether these gains translate into more reliable joint task performance.
paragraphs.zh: Dual Exam 诊断的是组件能力，而非共同演化本身。 我们观察到的执行与状态一致性失败指出了有用交互可能存在的障碍，而非学习能力有限的证据。 在装箱情形中，容器变化后命令仍继续执行（图 2）；这一观察结果促使进行诊断，但并未检验任一组件能否从交互中学习。 未来的工作应将联合更新与仅智能体更新、仅世界模型更新以及不更新等对照组进行比较，在各轮次与各随机种子下使用固定的留出测试，以追踪两个组件及闭环任务成功率。 这将检验两个组件是否在连续轮次中有所改进，以及这些改进能否转化为更可靠的联合任务表现。

sents.zh: 这将检验两个组件是否在连续轮次中有所改进，以及这些改进能否转化为更可靠的联合任务表现。

paragraphs.en: The observed cases suggest concrete targets for subsequent experiments. Invalid routes and action orders motivate explicit checks of global constraints before committing to a sequence. Changes in container identity, object count, or unrelated scene attributes motivate verification that requested updates preserve protected state. Resource-allocation examples motivate checks of joint constraints rather than individual choices alone. These are hypotheses motivated by illustrative failures, not established explanations of aggregate performance. Their utility should be tested through controlled interventions on the same cases, measuring both strict task completion and any separately defined intermediate progress.
paragraphs.zh: 所观察到的案例为后续实验提供了具体目标。 无效的路径和动作顺序促使我们在确定某个序列之前先对全局约束进行明确检查。 容器身份、对象数量或无关场景属性的变化促使我们验证所请求的更新是否会保留受保护的状态。 资源分配示例促使我们检查联合约束，而不仅是单独检查各个选择。 这些是由示例性失败所启发的假设，并非对总体表现的既定解释。 它们的效用应通过在同一案例上进行受控干预来检验，同时衡量严格的任务完成度以及任何单独定义的中间进展。

paragraphs.en: The reported scores depend on task selection, reference environments, verification rules, and configuration-specific execution settings. Fixed conditions reduce one source of variation but do not establish that the reference mechanism is error-free. The current presentation does not report an independent, stratified agreement estimate for the World Model output scores. The packing audit is additionally retrospective: its rubric was specified after inspecting the trajectory, and its labels have not been independently adjudicated. These limits should be addressed by documenting environment validation, auditing scored outputs independently, and reporting disagreements, ambiguous checks, and invalid-run counts. Such evidence is needed to quantify measurement reliability beyond the illustrative examples.
paragraphs.zh: 报告的分数取决于任务选择、参考环境、验证规则以及特定配置的执行设置。 固定条件减少了某一变化来源，但并不能证明参考机制是无错误的。 当前报告并未针对 World Model 输出分数提供独立的、分层的（stratified）一致性估计。 打包（packing）审计还是回顾性的：其评分标准是在检查轨迹之后才确定的，且其标签尚未经过独立裁定。 应通过记录环境验证、独立审计已评分的输出，并报告不一致之处、模糊的检查项以及无效运行次数，来解决这些局限。 需要此类证据来量化超出示例性例子之外的测量可靠性。

sents.zh: 报告的分数取决于任务选择、参考环境、验证规则以及特定配置的执行设置。

paragraphs.en: The Scientific scores combine binary repair and checkpoint outcomes with graded optimization results. Our clipping of Borden and DABIC to [ 0,100 ] [0,100] is a Dual Exam aggregation convention, not an official EdgeBench normalization rule; a shared range does not equate task difficulty. We retain valid Edge submissions recorded within the selected run’s allowance of at most 43,200 seconds, including submissions before early termination. This does not imply that every run completed the full horizon. The supplied trace archive is truncated: the four added configurations’ Wireless endpoints were checked against their best-submission judge reports, but the remaining added-task endpoints and evaluator-version equivalence have not all been independently verified. Execution harnesses also differ across configurations. Appendix A.13 preserves raw objectives and details these evidence limits.
paragraphs.zh: Scientific 分数将二元修复与检查点结果同分级优化的结果相结合。 我们将 Borden 和 DABIC 截断到 [0,100] 是一种 Dual Exam 的聚合约定，并非官方的 EdgeBench 归一化规则；共享同一取值范围并不意味着任务难度相同。 我们保留在所选运行允许的最多 43,200 秒内记录的有效 Edge 提交，包括在提前终止之前的提交。 这并不意味着每次运行都完成了完整的时间范围。 所提供的轨迹存档是截断的：四个新增配置的 Wireless 端点已对照其最佳提交的评审报告进行了核查，但其余新增任务的端点以及评估器版本的等效性尚未全部得到独立验证。 执行框架在不同配置之间也存在差异。 附录 A.13 保留了原始目标值，并详细说明了这些证据局限。

sents.en: Appendix A.13 preserves raw objectives and details these evidence limits.
sents.zh: 附录 A.13 保留了原始目标值，并详细说明了这些证据局限。

paragraphs.en: The leaderboard reports descriptive point scores, without repeated-run uncertainty estimates or significance tests. Differences between configurations therefore do not establish statistically significant superiority. Original category means are available only to one decimal place, so derived aggregates retain this baseline precision limit. The separate tracks also do not establish how component scores predict coupled performance. Action-sensitive validation would benefit from controls such as unchanged-frame, no-op, and shuffled-intervention outputs, with scoring targets defined in advance for each control. Matched interaction experiments and repeated evaluations are needed to test robustness, partner suitability, and the effect of corrective feedback. These questions are distinct from the descriptive rankings reported here.
paragraphs.zh: 该排行榜报告的是描述性的分数，没有重复运行的不确定性估计或显著性检验。 因此，不同配置之间的差异并不能证明具有统计学显著性的优越性。 原始类别均值只有一位小数，因此推导出的汇总指标仍受这一基线精度上限的约束。 各独立赛道也无法说明各组件分数如何预测耦合性能。 对动作敏感的验证将受益于诸如帧不变、无操作（no-op）与打乱干预输出等对照设置，并需事先为每种对照定义评分目标。 需要匹配的交互实验和重复评估来检验鲁棒性、伙伴适配性以及纠正性反馈的效果。 这些问题不同于本文报告的描述性排名。

paragraphs.en: We have not run copy-last-frame, no-op, or shuffled-action baselines for the present WM scores. A copy-last-frame control should be scored against the original requested changes and protected-state checks separately; a true no-op intervention should instead use an identity-transition target, and shuffled interventions require targets derived from the shuffled sequence. These controls test different failure modes and should not share an incompatible target. Likewise, budget curves and correction-versus-repetition tests require matched cases and equal resources. Existing multi-attempt illustrations are descriptive and do not substitute for such controls. A stratified independent output audit remains necessary before claiming calibrated judge reliability.
paragraphs.zh: 我们尚未针对当前的世界模型（WM）得分运行复制上一帧、无操作或动作打乱等基线。 复制上一帧对照应分别针对原始请求的变更和受保护状态检查来评分；真正的无操作干预应改用恒等转移目标，而打乱后的干预则需要从打乱后的序列导出的目标。 这些对照检验的是不同的失败模式，不应共用一个不兼容的目标。 同样，预算曲线和纠正与重复对比测试也需要匹配的案例和相等的资源。 现有的多次尝试示例只是描述性的，不能替代此类对照。 在宣称评判者可靠性已校准之前，仍需进行分层独立输出审计。

sents.zh: 我们尚未针对当前的世界模型（WM）得分运行复制上一帧、无操作或动作打乱等基线。

sents.zh: 复制上一帧对照应分别针对原始请求的变更和受保护状态检查来评分；真正的无操作干预应改用恒等转移目标，而打乱后的干预则需要从打乱后的序列导出的目标。

sents.en: These controls test different failure modes and should not share an incompatible target.
sents.zh: 这些对照检验的是不同的失败模式，不应共用一个不兼容的目标。

sents.en: Likewise, budget curves and correction-versus-repetition tests require matched cases and equal resources.
sents.zh: 同样，预算曲线和纠正与重复对比测试也需要匹配的案例和相等的资源。

sents.en: Existing multi-attempt illustrations are descriptive and do not substitute for such controls.
sents.zh: 现有的多次尝试示例只是描述性的，不能替代此类对照。

sents.en: A stratified independent output audit remains necessary before claiming calibrated judge reliability.
sents.zh: 在宣称评判者可靠性已校准之前，仍需进行分层独立输出审计。

paragraphs.en: Dual Exam evaluates Multimodal Agents under fixed environment response mechanisms and World Models under fixed action interventions, producing complementary performance profiles across four domains. The Agent evaluation compares 10 configurations on 1,088 items in 15 reporting categories; GPT 6 Astra achieves the highest case-weighted Index of 31.3. The World Model evaluation contains 400 cases across eight scenarios, with 50 cases per scenario. GPT-Image-2 leads the full-coverage WM Overall scores at 21.7. Configuration-specific coverage is reported separately, and the two tracks use different tasks and metrics, so their aggregate scores are not directly comparable. Scientific evaluation spans 109 items and combines strict repair and checkpoint outcomes with graded optimization scores; Astra leads its within-domain aggregate at 50.6. Category leaders differ, and equal-domain weighting changes the overall ordering below the leading configuration. The results characterize model–harness performance under the evaluated specifications and weighting choices, subject to the documented evidence and precision limits. Predicting coupled success and demonstrating sustained reciprocal improvement require matched interaction and learning experiments beyond these separate assessments.
paragraphs.zh: 双重考试在固定环境响应机制下评估多模态智能体，并在固定动作干预下评估世界模型，在四个领域产生互补的性能画像。 智能体评估在15个报告类别中对1,088个条目比较10种配置；GPT 6 Astra 以31.3的最高案例加权指数领先。 世界模型评估包含八个场景共400个案例，每个场景50个案例。 GPT-Image-2 以21.7领先全覆盖的世界模型总分。 各配置的覆盖率单独报告，且两条赛道使用不同的任务和指标，因此其汇总分数不可直接比较。 科学评估涵盖109个条目，将严格修复与检查点结果同分级优化得分相结合；Astra 以50.6领先其领域内汇总成绩。 各类别的领先者各不相同，且等权领域加权会改变领先配置之下的整体排序。 这些结果刻画了在所评估的规范与加权选择下模型—执行框架的性能，并受限于已记录的证据与精度限制。 预测耦合成功并展示持续的相互改进，需要在这些独立评估之外的匹配交互与学习实验。

paragraphs.en: This appendix describes the Agent evaluation across four domains and distinguishes the current reporting inventory from historical illustrative cases. The current leaderboard contains 1,088 items in 15 categories: four Physical, four Digital, three Social, and four Scientific categories. Appendix A.1 defines their scope and counts.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录描述了跨四个领域的智能体评估，并区分了当前的报告清单与历史示例案例。 当前的排行榜包含 15 个类别中的 1,088 个条目：四个物理类别、四个数字类别、三个社会类别和四个科学类别。 附录 A.1 定义了它们的范围和数量。

sents.en: This appendix describes the Agent evaluation across four domains and distinguishes the current reporting inventory from historical illustrative cases.
sents.zh: 本附录描述了跨四个领域的智能体评估，并区分了当前的报告清单与历史示例案例。

sents.en: The current leaderboard contains 1,088 items in 15 categories: four Physical, four Digital, three Social, and four Scientific categories.
sents.zh: 当前的排行榜包含 15 个类别中的 1,088 个条目：四个物理类别、四个数字类别、三个社会类别和四个科学类别。

sents.en: Appendix A.1 defines their scope and counts.
sents.zh: 附录 A.1 定义了它们的范围和数量。

paragraphs.en: The figures include reference demonstrations, execution screenshots, saved predictions, and recorded outcomes. Reference demonstrations illustrate intended behavior; model trajectories illustrate particular successes or failures. Historical workflow-oriented headings are not additional categories in the current leaderboard, and illustrative cases do not by themselves establish coverage or model rankings. Historical examples are used here to explain task requirements and scoring behavior, rather than to support quantitative conclusions about the current inventory.
paragraphs.zh: 这些图表包括参考演示、执行截图、保存的预测结果以及记录的结果。 参考演示展示预期行为；模型轨迹展示具体的成功或失败情况。 以往面向工作流程的标题并不是当前排行榜中的额外类别，示例案例本身也不能确立覆盖范围或模型排名。 此处使用历史示例是为了解释任务要求和评分行为，而不是为了支持关于当前清单的定量结论。

paragraphs.en: We organize the agent evaluation using three levels: domains, task categories, and individual evaluation items. The four domains provide complementary settings for examining goal-directed behavior: Physical concerns actions and constraints in physical scenes; Digital concerns interaction with software interfaces; Social concerns decisions involving other agents and shared resources; and Scientific concerns technical workflows with checkable scientific or computational deliverables. This is an operational organization of the selected benchmark tasks, rather than an exhaustive taxonomy of intelligence or evidence that the domains measure independent latent abilities. In particular, scientific tasks can use digital interfaces, and physical tasks can involve both planning and manipulation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将智能体评估组织为三个层级：领域、任务类别和单个评估项。 这四个领域为考察目标导向行为提供了互补的场景：物理领域关注物理场景中的动作与约束；数字领域关注与软件界面的交互；社会领域关注涉及其他智能体和共享资源的决策；科学领域关注具有可检验的科学或计算交付物的技术工作流。 这是对所选基准任务的一种操作性组织方式，而不是关于智能的完备分类法，也不是这些领域能够测量相互独立的潜在能力的证据。 特别地，科学任务可以使用数字界面，而物理任务可能同时涉及规划与操作。

paragraphs.en: Within each domain, categories describe the distinctions supported by its task collection. Physical categories emphasize task demands, Digital categories emphasize interaction environments, Social categories distinguish strategic interaction and resource-governance settings, and Scientific categories organize subject matter. We therefore use task categories , rather than treating all category labels as equivalent, mutually exclusive cognitive capabilities. The mixed organizing criteria support interpretable reporting of this inventory but limit claims about universal capability coverage.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个领域内部，类别描述其任务集合所支持的区分。 物理类别强调任务需求，数字类别强调交互环境，社会类别区分策略性互动与资源治理情境，科学类别则按学科内容进行组织。 因此，我们使用任务类别，而不是把所有类别标签视为等同的、互斥的认知能力。 这种混合的组织标准支持对这份清单进行可解释的呈现，但限制了对普遍能力覆盖范围的主张。

sents.en: Physical categories emphasize task demands, Digital categories emphasize interaction environments, Social categories distinguish strategic interaction and resource-governance settings, and Scientific categories organize subject matter.

paragraphs.en: The recorded task descriptions provide a concrete distinction. Planning involves organizing dependent actions to satisfy household goals, illustrated by dinner preparation and household restoration. Action Sequencing instead presents initial and target states together with a shuffled pool of action clips: each problem requires assigning clips to two tasks and reconstructing both reference orders. This distinction is between goal-directed planning and constrained sequence reconstruction, not between the presence and absence of planning ability. Navigation evaluates agent-specific traversability and valid routes, whereas Manipulation evaluates changes to object configurations. Success in one category should not be interpreted as isolating a single cognitive mechanism.
paragraphs.zh: 所记录的任务描述提供了一个具体的区分。 规划涉及组织具有依赖关系的动作以满足家庭目标，并以晚餐准备和房屋修复为例加以说明。 动作排序（Action Sequencing）则将初始状态、目标状态与一组打乱顺序的动作片段一起呈现：每个问题需要将片段分配到两个任务中，并重建两者的参考顺序。 这一区分存在于目标导向的规划与受约束的序列重建之间，而不是规划能力的有无之间。 导航评估智能体特定的可通行性与有效路径，而操纵评估物体配置的变化。 某一类别上的成功不应被解读为分离出了单一的 cognitive 机制，即不应被解读为隔离了单一的认知机制。

paragraphs.en: The four categories identify the primary interaction setting. Web Interaction covers browser-based tasks; desktop and mobile categories identify application environments; game tasks are reported separately as game environments. These settings share requirements such as perception, planning, interface operation, and recovery from errors. A game accessed through a browser can consequently overlap conceptually with web interaction. For reproducible aggregation, each item retains one primary reporting assignment in the inventory; shared demands can be described separately without counting the item twice. The platform label alone does not establish a distinct underlying capability.
paragraphs.zh: 这四个类别标识了主要的交互环境。 网页交互涵盖基于浏览器的任务；桌面和移动类别标识应用程序环境；游戏任务被单独归入游戏环境进行报告。 这些环境共享诸如感知、规划、界面操作以及从错误中恢复等需求。 因此，通过浏览器访问的游戏在概念上可以与网页交互产生重叠。 为实现可复现的汇总，每个条目在清单中只保留一个主要的报告归类；共享的需求可以单独描述，而不会将该条目重复计算。 仅凭平台标签并不能确立一项独特的底层能力。

paragraphs.en: The 200 social cases instantiate 40 task templates. Coordination & Strategic Interaction contains 87 cases from 17 templates, including bargaining, congestion coordination, public-goods dilemmas, negotiation, and persuasion. The remaining two families both involve shared-resource decisions: 56 cases from 11 templates concern aquatic, soil, and climate resources, while 57 cases from 12 templates concern terrestrial ecosystems, agricultural or forest resources, and health-related resources such as antibiotics. We retain these two settings for separate reporting because they specify different resource contexts; this is not evidence that they measure two independent governance abilities. Ecological boundaries can overlap, so the task’s recorded primary resource setting determines its reporting assignment. The older labels Natural Allocation and Society Access are replaced here by descriptions of the actual task content.
paragraphs.zh: 这200个社会案例实例化了40个任务模板。 协调与策略互动包含来自17个模板的87个案例，涉及讨价还价、拥堵协调、公共品困境、谈判和说服。 其余两个家族均涉及共享资源决策：来自11个模板的56个案例涉及水生、土壤和气候资源，而来自12个模板的57个案例涉及陆地生态系统、农业或森林资源以及抗生素等与健康相关的资源。 我们保留这两个场景并分别报告，因为它们规定了不同的资源背景；这并不是它们测量两种独立治理能力的证据。 生态边界可能重叠，因此以任务记录的主要资源场景决定其报告归属。 这里用对实际任务内容的描述取代了较早的「自然分配」和「社会获取」标签。

paragraphs.en: The current scientific inventory contains 109 tasks: 63 ALE tasks, 30 SWE-bench repair tasks, ten derived ToolChoice tasks, and six EdgeBench optimization tasks. Its subject labels are reporting assignments, not an assertion that scientific disciplines have disjoint methods. Health & Medicine emphasizes health-related objectives, whereas Life Sciences emphasizes biological investigation; Mathematics & Computation includes tasks organized around mathematical or computational outputs. Existing assignments are retained for score traceability, including cross-disciplinary cases: for example, the quantum Ising-chain computation is assigned to Mathematics & Computation in the source mapping. A stricter subject-based reassignment would require an explicit revision and recomputation of category scores.
paragraphs.zh: 当前科学任务清单共包含 109 项任务：63 项 ALE 任务、30 项 SWE-bench 修复任务、10 项派生的 ToolChoice 任务，以及 6 项 EdgeBench 优化任务。 其学科标签仅表示任务归属，并非断言各科学学科的方法彼此割裂。 健康与医学侧重于健康相关目标，而生命科学侧重于生物学研究；数学与计算包含围绕数学或计算输出组织的任务。 现有任务归属被保留以保证分数可追溯，包括跨学科的案例：例如，量子 Ising 链计算在源映射中被归入数学与计算。 若要按更严格的学科标准重新分配任务，则需要明确修订并重新计算各类别分数。

paragraphs.en: The original 13-item ALE Physical Sciences group includes materials and molecular calculations, but also climate simulation, lake-model calibration, orbital transfer, and Hubble-image processing. paragraphs.en: The current Agent inventory contains 1,088 evaluation tasks in 15 reporting categories across four domains: 524 Physical, 255 Digital, 200 Social, and 109 Scientific. The Scientific domain combines 63 selected tasks from Agents’ Last Exam (ALE), 30 scientific code-repair tasks sourced from SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al., 2023 ) , ten ToolChoice tasks derived from the repair workflows, and six EdgeBench optimization tasks. Each ToolChoice task inherits its parent repair task’s subject category but constitutes a distinct evaluated decision checkpoint. The 109 tasks therefore include 99 full workflows and ten checkpoints; their related provenance does not imply independent observations. Six EdgeBench optimization tasks are included; the other 84 historical ALE tasks remain excluded. Table 5 gives the category counts, while Table 10 separates subject category from task source.
paragraphs.zh: 当前的智能体清单包含 1,088 个评估任务，涵盖 15 个报告类别和四个领域：物理领域 524 个、数字领域 255 个、社会领域 200 个和科学领域 109 个。 科学领域合并了来自 Agents' Last Exam（ALE）的 63 个选定任务、源自 SWE-bench（Jimenez 等，2023）的 30 个科学代码修复任务、从修复工作流衍生出的十个 ToolChoice 任务，以及六个 EdgeBench 优化任务。 每个 ToolChoice 任务继承其父修复任务的主题类别，但构成一个独立的评估决策检查点。 因此，这 109 个任务包括 99 个完整工作流和十个检查点；它们之间的来源关联并不意味着这些是相互独立的观测。 收录了六个 EdgeBench 优化任务；其余 84 个历史 ALE 任务仍未收录。 表 5 给出类别数量，而表 10 将主题类别与任务来源分开列出。

paragraphs.en: Both calculations retain the original one-decimal category means as baseline and incorporate the added binary outcomes and graded Edge scores before final rounding. The extra decimal shown here explains the computed ordering but does not recover lost baseline precision. This is an aggregation sensitivity analysis, not an uncertainty estimate.
paragraphs.zh: 两种计算均保留原始的一位小数类别均值作为基线，并在最终舍入之前纳入新增的二分类结局和分级 Edge 分数。 此处显示的额外小数位解释了计算所得的排序，但无法恢复已丢失的基线精度。 这是一项聚合敏感性分析，而非不确定性估计。

paragraphs.en: GPT 6 Astra ranks first under both mixtures, but several other positions change substantially. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash moves from sixth to second and Kimi K3 from fifth to fourth. The case-weighted Index should therefore be interpreted as performance on the configured inventory rather than a distribution-independent ordering of general Agent ability. Confidence intervals and paired model comparisons require the underlying evaluation records and a resampling unit that accounts for shared templates and the SWE/ToolChoice parent links. In particular, the 200 Social cases instantiate 40 templates and should not automatically be treated as independent observations.
paragraphs.zh: GPT 6 Astra 在两种权重下均排名第一，但其他多个名次发生了显著变化。 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 从第六名升至第二名，Kimi K3 从第五名升至第四名。 因此，按案例加权的指数应被解读为在所配置任务清单上的表现，而非一种独立于分布的通用智能体能力排序。 置信区间和配对模型比较需要底层的评估记录，以及一个能够考虑共享模板和 SWE/ToolChoice 父链接的重新抽样单元。 特别地，200 个 Social 案例实例化了 40 个模板，不应自动被视为相互独立的观测值。

paragraphs.en: Planning tests whether an Agent can organize dependent actions to satisfy a household goal. The evaluation set contains 30 tasks. Figure 6 introduces four task workflows through reference demonstrations D1–D4, pairing a scene image with selected actions and the final goal indicators. These are demonstrations of the required behavior, rather than evaluated model predictions. The numbered events locate actions within the replay, while the separate timestamps identify the video moments used for the scene image and event annotations.
paragraphs.zh: 规划测试智能体是否能组织有依赖关系的动作以完成家庭目标。 评估集包含30个任务。 图6通过参考演示D1–D4介绍四种任务工作流，将场景图像与所选动作及最终目标指示器配对。 这些是所需行为的演示，而非被评估的模型预测。 编号事件在回放中定位动作，而单独的时间戳则标识用于场景图像和事件标注的视频时刻。

paragraphs.en: D1: Dinner preparation. The 105-step demonstration combines food handling, tableware arrangement, and household tidying. The figure highlights placing chicken at step 16, moving near the dining table at step 56, and storing a board game at step 93. All six displayed goal groups are satisfied at the end of the episode, illustrating how a single household objective can require actions involving several kinds of objects.
paragraphs.zh: D1：晚餐准备。 这段105步的演示结合了食物处理、餐具摆放和家务整理。 该图突出显示了在第16步放置鸡肉、在第56步移动到餐桌附近、以及在第93步收纳一个桌游。 展示的六个目标组在片段结束时全部得到满足，说明单个家庭目标可能需要涉及多种物体的动作。

paragraphs.en: The physical model evaluations use reasoning effort high and each model’s maximum supported output-token limit. These settings do not apply to the planning reference demonstrations. The manipulation recordings also use different historical controller configurations, so they support case interpretation rather than a controlled model comparison. The stored InternVLA_A15 / arx_x5 label identifies the setup without separately verifying the upstream planning model.
paragraphs.zh: 物理模型评估使用高推理强度以及每个模型所支持的最大输出token上限。 这些设置不适用于规划参考演示。 操作录制还使用了不同的历史控制器配置，因此它们支持案例解读，而非受控的模型比较。 所存储的 InternVLA_A15 / arx_x5 标签标识的是该硬件配置，并未单独验证上游规划模型。

paragraphs.en: R1: Successful ball pouring. The frames show a gripper moving the yellow container over the vase and tipping it during the attempt. The official result records success and a score of 1.0. The case illustrates how the initial arrangement, intermediate pouring action, and recorded outcome together describe completion of the object-transfer task.
paragraphs.zh: R1：成功的倒球。 帧画面显示夹爪将黄色容器移到花瓶上方并在尝试过程中将其倾斜。 官方结果记录为成功，得分为 1.0。 该案例展示了初始摆放、中间倒球动作和记录的结果如何共同描述物体转移任务的完成。

sents.en: R1: Successful ball pouring.
sents.zh: R1：成功的倒球。

paragraphs.en: R2: Successful bowl stacking. The initial frame shows three separate bowls, followed by a gripper moving a bowl toward the others. The official result records success and a score of 1.0. The sampled views illustrate the progression from separate objects toward a stack, while the episode result determines whether the final arrangement satisfies the task.

paragraphs.en: R3: Incomplete cloth folding. The garment changes from a spread configuration to a more compact shape across the sampled frames. Nevertheless, the official result records failure with a score of 0.2. This contrast shows why visible deformation or partial folding should not be treated as completion: the episode does not satisfy the full folding objective.
paragraphs.zh: R3：布料折叠未完成。 在采样的各帧中，衣物从展开状态变为更紧凑的形态。 然而，官方结果记录为失败，得分为 0.2。 这一对比说明为什么可见的形变或部分折叠不应被视为完成：该回合并未满足完整的折叠目标。

sents.zh: 这一对比说明为什么可见的形变或部分折叠不应被视为完成：该回合并未满足完整的折叠目标。

paragraphs.en: R4: Unsuccessful key insertion. The sampled frames show the grippers approaching and manipulating the key and its receiving object. The official result records failure with a score of 0.15. The nonzero score is partial evaluation credit; the three frames cannot determine exactly why insertion failed or how many required actions were completed.
paragraphs.zh: R4：钥匙插入失败。 采样帧显示夹爪正在接近并操作钥匙及其接收对象。 官方结果记录为失败，得分为 0.15。 非零分数是部分评估得分；这三帧无法确定插入失败的确切原因或已完成多少所需动作。

paragraphs.en: Navigation tests whether an Agent can infer who can traverse a scene and produce a valid route. Each of the 282 questions supplies a scene-tour video and asks for decisions for five agent types: HUMAN, WHEELCHAIR, HUMANOID, QUADRUPEDAL, and SWEEPER. A question passes only if all five feasibility decisions are correct and every required route connects the specified endpoints through existing, traversable graph edges. Figure 8 separates these two checks by showing feasibility decisions alongside the predicted HUMAN route.
paragraphs.zh: 导航测试考察智能体能否推断谁能穿越某个场景，并产出一条有效路线。 282 个问题中的每一个都提供一段场景漫游视频，并要求针对五种智能体类型做出判断：HUMAN（人类）、WHEELCHAIR（轮椅）、HUMANOID（人形）、QUADRUPEDAL（四足）和 SWEEPER（清扫机）。 只有当全部五个可行性判断都正确，且每条所需路线都通过现有的、可通行的图边连接指定端点时，该问题才算通过。 图 8 将这两项检查分开呈现，在展示可行性判断的同时展示了预测的 HUMAN（人类）路线。

sents.en: Navigation tests whether an Agent can infer who can traverse a scene and produce a valid route.
sents.zh: 导航测试考察智能体能否推断谁能穿越某个场景，并产出一条有效路线。

sents.en: Each of the 282 questions supplies a scene-tour video and asks for decisions for five agent types: HUMAN, WHEELCHAIR, HUMANOID, QUADRUPEDAL, and SWEEPER.
sents.zh: 282 个问题中的每一个都提供一段场景漫游视频，并要求针对五种智能体类型做出判断：HUMAN（人类）、WHEELCHAIR（轮椅）、HUMANOID（人形）、QUADRUPEDAL（四足）和 SWEEPER（清扫机）。

sents.en: A question passes only if all five feasibility decisions are correct and every required route connects the specified endpoints through existing, traversable graph edges.
sents.zh: 只有当全部五个可行性判断都正确，且每条所需路线都通过现有的、可通行的图边连接指定端点时，该问题才算通过。

sents.en: Figure 8 separates these two checks by showing feasibility decisions alongside the predicted HUMAN route.
sents.zh: 图 8 将这两项检查分开呈现，在展示可行性判断的同时展示了预测的 HUMAN（人类）路线。

paragraphs.en: The four cases use saved Gemini 3.6 Flash predictions and include two successes and two failures. We checked the predictions against the specified task maps and movement rules. Scene images identify the environment rather than the precise route endpoints, and the displayed reference is one valid route rather than the only permitted answer. The saved predictions are checked against the available task definitions; later responses and reindexed copies are excluded because the original API responses are unavailable.
paragraphs.zh: 四个案例使用的是已保存的 Gemini 3.6 Flash 预测结果，包含两个成功案例和两个失败案例。 我们根据指定的任务地图和移动规则核对了这些预测结果。 场景图像用于标识环境而非精确的路线端点，且所展示的参考路线只是一条有效路线，而非唯一被允许的答案。 已保存的预测结果会与可用的任务定义进行核对；由于原始 API 响应不可用，后续的响应和重新编号的副本已被排除在外。

sents.en: The four cases use saved Gemini 3.6 Flash predictions and include two successes and two failures.
sents.zh: 四个案例使用的是已保存的 Gemini 3.6 Flash 预测结果，包含两个成功案例和两个失败案例。

sents.en: We checked the predictions against the specified task maps and movement rules.
sents.zh: 我们根据指定的任务地图和移动规则核对了这些预测结果。

paragraphs.en: N1: Valid routes for two agent types. In scene HM3D00000 (question 00000011), the route runs from the living-room fireplace area to the master-bedroom wardrobe. The model correctly permits HUMAN and QUADRUPEDAL and rejects the other three types. Both required routes are valid, so all five outputs pass the combined feasibility and route checks.
paragraphs.zh: N1: 两种智能体类型的有效路线。 在场景 HM3D00000（问题 00000011）中，该路线从客厅壁炉区域通往主卧衣柜。 该模型正确地允许 HUMAN 和 QUADRUPEDAL，并拒绝其余三种类型。 两条所需路线均有效，因此全部五个输出都通过了合并的可行性与路线检查。

sents.en: N1: Valid routes for two agent types.
sents.zh: N1: 两种智能体类型的有效路线。

sents.en: In scene HM3D00000 (question 00000011), the route runs from the living-room fireplace area to the master-bedroom wardrobe.
sents.zh: 在场景 HM3D00000（问题 00000011）中，该路线从客厅壁炉区域通往主卧衣柜。

sents.en: The model correctly permits HUMAN and QUADRUPEDAL and rejects the other three types.
sents.zh: 该模型正确地允许 HUMAN 和 QUADRUPEDAL，并拒绝其余三种类型。

sents.en: Both required routes are valid, so all five outputs pass the combined feasibility and route checks.
sents.zh: 两条所需路线均有效，因此全部五个输出都通过了合并的可行性与路线检查。

paragraphs.en: N2: Valid routes for three agent types. In scene HM3D00027 (question 00000871), the route runs from a living-room sofa to the kitchen stove. HUMAN, QUADRUPEDAL, and SWEEPER are feasible, and the evaluated model supplies valid routes for them. All five outputs pass; accessibility depends on the specific scene and destination.
paragraphs.zh: N2：三种智能体类型的有效路径。 在场景 HM3D00027（问题 00000871）中，路径从客厅沙发通向厨房炉灶。 HUMAN、QUADRUPEDAL 和 SWEEPER 是可行的，被评估的模型为它们提供了有效路径。 所有五个输出均通过；可达性取决于具体场景和目的地。

sents.en: N2: Valid routes for three agent types.
sents.zh: N2：三种智能体类型的有效路径。

sents.en: In scene HM3D00027 (question 00000871), the route runs from a living-room sofa to the kitchen stove.
sents.zh: 在场景 HM3D00027（问题 00000871）中，路径从客厅沙发通向厨房炉灶。

sents.en: HUMAN, QUADRUPEDAL, and SWEEPER are feasible, and the evaluated model supplies valid routes for them.
sents.zh: HUMAN、QUADRUPEDAL 和 SWEEPER 是可行的，被评估的模型为它们提供了有效路径。

sents.en: All five outputs pass; accessibility depends on the specific scene and destination.
sents.zh: 所有五个输出均通过；可达性取决于具体场景和目的地。

paragraphs.en: N3: Correct feasibility, invalid routes. In scene HM3D00002 (question 00000051), all five feasibility decisions are correct, but the HUMAN and QUADRUPEDAL routes include the nonexistent edge from node 6 to node 7. The accompanying figure shows this missing connection in red. Only three of five complete outputs pass, because correctly predicting that a destination is reachable does not guarantee that the proposed route reaches it.
paragraphs.zh: N3：可行性判断正确，但路径无效。 在场景 HM3D00002（问题 00000051）中，全部五项可行性判断均正确，但 HUMAN（人类）和 QUADRUPEDAL（四足）的路径包含了从节点 6 到节点 7 的不存在的边。 附图用红色标出了这条缺失的连接。 五个完整输出中只有三个通过，因为正确预测某个目的地可达，并不能保证所提出的路径确实能到达该目的地。

sents.en: N3: Correct feasibility, invalid routes.
sents.zh: N3：可行性判断正确，但路径无效。

sents.en: In scene HM3D00002 (question 00000051), all five feasibility decisions are correct, but the HUMAN and QUADRUPEDAL routes include the nonexistent edge from node 6 to node 7.
sents.zh: 在场景 HM3D00002（问题 00000051）中，全部五项可行性判断均正确，但 HUMAN（人类）和 QUADRUPEDAL（四足）的路径包含了从节点 6 到节点 7 的不存在的边。

sents.en: The accompanying figure shows this missing connection in red.
sents.zh: 附图用红色标出了这条缺失的连接。

sents.en: Only three of five complete outputs pass, because correctly predicting that a destination is reachable does not guarantee that the proposed route reaches it.

paragraphs.en: N4: Incorrect feasibility and routes. In scene MP3D00003 (question 00001471), the reference permits only HUMAN, whereas the evaluated model permits all five types. The model-predicted routes also contain the nonexistent edge from node 45 to node 40. Thus, one feasibility decision is correct but no complete output passes; the case illustrates separate errors in assessing accessibility and constructing a route through the scene.
paragraphs.zh: N4：可行性判断和路径均不正确。 在场景 MP3D00003（问题 00001471）中，参考答案仅允许 HUMAN，而被评估的模型允许全部五种类型。 模型预测的路径中还包含从节点 45 到节点 40 的不存在的边。 因此，只有一个可行性判断是正确的，但没有完整的输出通过；该案例展示了在评估可达性和构建穿越场景的路径时分别出现的错误。

sents.en: N4: Incorrect feasibility and routes.
sents.zh: N4：可行性判断和路径均不正确。

sents.en: In scene MP3D00003 (question 00001471), the reference permits only HUMAN, whereas the evaluated model permits all five types.
sents.zh: 在场景 MP3D00003（问题 00001471）中，参考答案仅允许 HUMAN，而被评估的模型允许全部五种类型。

sents.en: The model-predicted routes also contain the nonexistent edge from node 45 to node 40.
sents.zh: 模型预测的路径中还包含从节点 45 到节点 40 的不存在的边。

sents.en: Thus, one feasibility decision is correct but no complete output passes; the case illustrates separate errors in assessing accessibility and constructing a route through the scene.
sents.zh: 因此，只有一个可行性判断是正确的，但没有完整的输出通过；该案例展示了在评估可达性和构建穿越场景的路径时分别出现的错误。

paragraphs.en: Action Sequencing assesses whether an Agent can reconstruct actions that connect an initial state to a target state. Each of the 170 problems contains two tasks and one shared, shuffled pool of action clips. The evaluated model must assign every clip to a task and order the resulting sequences without being told their lengths. Success requires an exact match to both reference sequences. Figures 9 – 12 place the initial and target states above the clip pool and compare the reference and model-predicted orders for each task for direct comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 动作排序评估智能体能否重构出连接初始状态与目标状态的动作序列。 每道题（共170道）包含两个任务和一个共享的、经打乱的动作片段池。 被评估的模型必须将每个片段分配给某个任务，并在未被告知序列长度的情况下对所得序列进行排序。 成功需要与两个参考序列完全匹配。 图9–12将初始状态和目标状态置于片段池上方，并对每个任务比较参考顺序与模型预测的顺序，以便直接对比。

sents.en: Action Sequencing assesses whether an Agent can reconstruct actions that connect an initial state to a target state.
sents.zh: 动作排序评估智能体能否重构出连接初始状态与目标状态的动作序列。

sents.en: Each of the 170 problems contains two tasks and one shared, shuffled pool of action clips.
sents.zh: 每道题（共170道）包含两个任务和一个共享的、经打乱的动作片段池。

sents.en: The evaluated model must assign every clip to a task and order the resulting sequences without being told their lengths.
sents.zh: 被评估的模型必须将每个片段分配给某个任务，并在未被告知序列长度的情况下对所得序列进行排序。

sents.en: Success requires an exact match to both reference sequences.
sents.zh: 成功需要与两个参考序列完全匹配。

sents.en: Figures 9 – 12 place the initial and target states above the clip pool and compare the reference and model-predicted orders for each task for direct comparison.
sents.zh: 图9–12将初始状态和目标状态置于片段池上方，并对每个任务比较参考顺序与模型预测的顺序，以便直接对比。

paragraphs.en: The examples use saved Qwen3.8-max-preview predictions, checked against the fixed task definitions, with two successes and two failures. Clip IDs retain their original meaning within each problem. Blue tokens denote the reference; green and red prediction tokens mark agreement or disagreement at the same sequence position. Original API responses are not available, and later generated responses and reindexed copies are excluded from the analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 示例使用了保存的 Qwen3.8-max-preview 预测结果，并与固定的任务定义进行了核对，其中包含两个成功案例和两个失败案例。 剪辑 ID 在每个问题中保留其原始含义。 蓝色标记表示参考内容；绿色和红色预测标记表示在相同序列位置上的一致或不一致。 原始 API 响应不可用，后续生成的响应和重新索引的副本已被排除在分析之外。

paragraphs.en: W1: Correct sequences of different lengths. CrossTask pair 013 combines food preparation and a wheel-change task. The predicted sequences [7, 2, 6] and [5, 1, 4, 3] match both references, correctly dividing seven clips into groups of three and four. Figure 9 depicts exact reconstruction of both sequences without assuming equal lengths.
paragraphs.zh: W1：不同长度的正确序列。 CrossTask 对 013 结合了食物准备和换轮胎任务。 预测序列 [7, 2, 6] 和 [5, 1, 4, 3] 与两个参考序列都匹配，正确地将七个片段划分为三个和四个的两组。 图 9 展示了在不假设长度相等的情况下对两个序列的精确重构。

sents.en: W1: Correct sequences of different lengths.
sents.zh: W1：不同长度的正确序列。

sents.en: CrossTask pair 013 combines food preparation and a wheel-change task.
sents.zh: CrossTask 对 013 结合了食物准备和换轮胎任务。

sents.en: The predicted sequences [7, 2, 6] and [5, 1, 4, 3] match both references, correctly dividing seven clips into groups of three and four.
sents.zh: 预测序列 [7, 2, 6] 和 [5, 1, 4, 3] 与两个参考序列都匹配，正确地将七个片段划分为三个和四个的两组。

sents.en: Figure 9 depicts exact reconstruction of both sequences without assuming equal lengths.
sents.zh: 图 9 展示了在不假设长度相等的情况下对两个序列的精确重构。

paragraphs.en: W2: Correct sequences of equal lengths. COIN pair 136 involves applying screen protectors to different devices. The model predicts [3, 5, 4, 1] and [7, 6, 2, 8], matching both four-step references. Figure 10 shows that all eight clips are assigned and ordered correctly despite the visual similarity of the two preparation and application workflows.
paragraphs.zh: W2：长度相等的正确序列。 COIN 第 136 对涉及将屏幕保护膜贴到不同设备上。 模型预测出 [3, 5, 4, 1] 和 [7, 6, 2, 8]，与两个四步参考序列均匹配。 图 10 显示，尽管两个准备和工作流程在视觉上相似，所有八个片段仍被正确分配和排序。

sents.en: W2: Correct sequences of equal lengths.
sents.zh: W2：长度相等的正确序列。

sents.en: COIN pair 136 involves applying screen protectors to different devices.
sents.zh: COIN 第 136 对涉及将屏幕保护膜贴到不同设备上。

sents.en: The model predicts [3, 5, 4, 1] and [7, 6, 2, 8], matching both four-step references.

sents.en: Figure 10 shows that all eight clips are assigned and ordered correctly despite the visual similarity of the two preparation and application workflows.
sents.zh: 图 10 显示，尽管两个准备和工作流程在视觉上相似，所有八个片段仍被正确分配和排序。

paragraphs.en: W3: Correct clips in the wrong order. COIN pair 002 combines a filter-replacement task with work on a bicycle. The references are [5, 3, 2] and [6, 4, 1], but the evaluated model predicts [3, 5, 2] and [4, 1, 6]. Each task receives the correct clips, yet neither order matches. The positional mismatches in Figure 11 demonstrate that identifying the relevant clips and ordering them correctly are separate requirements for task success in the required workflow.
paragraphs.zh: W3：正确的剪辑片段顺序错误。 COIN 配对 002 将更换滤芯的任务与修理自行车的工作组合在一起。 参考答案是 [5, 3, 2] 和 [6, 4, 1]，但被评估的模型预测出 [3, 5, 2] 和 [4, 1, 6]。 每个任务都收到了正确的剪辑片段，但两者的顺序都不匹配。 图 11 中的位置错配表明，在所需的工作流程中，识别相关剪辑片段并对其正确排序是任务成功的两个独立要求。

sents.en: W3: Correct clips in the wrong order.
sents.zh: W3：正确的剪辑片段顺序错误。

sents.en: COIN pair 002 combines a filter-replacement task with work on a bicycle.
sents.zh: COIN 配对 002 将更换滤芯的任务与修理自行车的工作组合在一起。

sents.en: The references are [5, 3, 2] and [6, 4, 1], but the evaluated model predicts [3, 5, 2] and [4, 1, 6].
Each task receives the correct clips, yet neither order matches.
sents.zh: 每个任务都收到了正确的剪辑片段，但两者的顺序都不匹配。

sents.en: The positional mismatches in Figure 11 demonstrate that identifying the relevant clips and ordering them correctly are separate requirements for task success in the required workflow.
sents.zh: 图 11 中的位置错配表明，在所需的工作流程中，识别相关剪辑片段并对其正确排序是任务成功的两个独立要求。

paragraphs.en: W4: Incorrect task lengths and clip assignment. IKEAASM pair 000 contains two furniture-assembly tasks with reference sequences [9, 8, 6, 3] and [2, 10, 7, 4, 1, 5]. The evaluated model instead returns [9, 6, 10, 4, 1] and [8, 2, 3, 7, 5]. Figure 12 depicts a five-plus-five division rather than the required four-plus-six division. Every clip is used once, but several belong to the other task, and neither sequence is correct for the assembly objective.
paragraphs.zh: W4：任务长度与片段分配不正确。 IKEAASM 第 000 对包含两个家具组装任务，其参考序列分别为 [9, 8, 6, 3] 和 [2, 10, 7, 4, 1, 5]。 被评估的模型却返回了 [9, 6, 10, 4, 1] 和 [8, 2, 3, 7, 5]。 图 12 展示的是五加五的划分，而非所需的四加六的划分。 每个片段都被使用了一次，但其中有几个片段属于另一个任务，且两个序列都不符合组装目标。

sents.en: W4: Incorrect task lengths and clip assignment.
sents.zh: W4：任务长度与片段分配不正确。

sents.en: The evaluated model instead returns [9, 6, 10, 4, 1] and [8, 2, 3, 7, 5].
Figure 12 depicts a five-plus-five division rather than the required four-plus-six division.
sents.zh: 图 12 展示的是五加五的划分，而非所需的四加六的划分。

sents.zh: 每个片段都被使用了一次，但其中有几个片段属于另一个任务，且两个序列都不符合组装目标。

paragraphs.en: The digital set contains 255 tasks: Web Interaction (WI; 74), Desktop Application Interaction (DAI; 95), Mobile Application Interaction (MAI; 35), and Game Environment Interaction (GEI; 51). The numerical tables below use these abbreviations. These tasks assess whether an Agent can use interface observations and tool feedback to complete a concrete request. Table 7 summarizes the abilities and evidence examined in each category. The selected examples follow the specified task from its requirements through actions in the execution record to an evaluation result, with progress toward the objective distinguished from full completion.
paragraphs.zh: 数字集合包含255个任务：网页交互（WI；74）、桌面应用交互（DAI；95）、移动应用交互（MAI；35）和游戏环境交互（GEI；51）。 下方数值表使用这些缩写。 这些任务评估智能体能否利用界面观察和工具反馈来完成具体请求。 表7总结了每个类别所考察的能力和证据。 所选示例从任务需求出发，经过执行记录中的操作，直到评估结果，并区分了向目标推进的程度与完全完成。

paragraphs.en: The browsing cases show five improvements and five contrasting failures across repeated attempts; none earns full credit. The desktop, mobile, and game-control cases meet their respective task criteria. A separate kitchen-planning demonstration and ten reference scene views explain interactive planning tasks. These sources have different purposes and are not combined into a single success rate; changes across browsing attempts also do not isolate the effect of memory from differences in tool activity or evaluation conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 浏览案例在多次尝试中展示了五项改进和五项形成对比的失败；没有一个案例获得满分。 桌面、移动端和游戏控制案例均满足各自的任务标准。 另外一个厨房规划演示和十个参考场景视图解释了交互式规划任务。 这些来源的用途各不相同，并未合并为单一的成功率；浏览尝试中的变化也未将记忆的作用与工具活动或评估条件的差异区分开来。

sents.en: The browsing cases show five improvements and five contrasting failures across repeated attempts; none earns full credit.
sents.zh: 浏览案例在多次尝试中展示了五项改进和五项形成对比的失败；没有一个案例获得满分。

sents.zh: 桌面、移动端和游戏控制案例均满足各自的任务标准。

paragraphs.en: Web browsing assesses whether an Agent can turn product requirements into purchasing information supported by identifiable sources. Each task requires finding suitable configurations, checking all requested properties, collecting exact purchase pages with displayed prices, and submitting a report. The evaluation distinguishes a filled answer field from a verified claim, so broad product coverage alone is insufficient for a high score and a fully supported report.
paragraphs.zh: 网页浏览评估智能体能否将产品需求转化为有可识别来源支持的商品购买信息。 每个任务都要求找到合适的配置，核对所有要求的属性，收集显示价格的准确购买页面，并提交一份报告。 该评估区分已填写的答案字段与经过验证的结论，因此仅有广泛的产品覆盖不足以获得高分，还需要一份有充分依据支撑的报告。

sents.en: Web browsing assesses whether an Agent can turn product requirements into purchasing information supported by identifiable sources.
sents.zh: 网页浏览评估智能体能否将产品需求转化为有可识别来源支持的商品购买信息。

sents.en: Each task requires finding suitable configurations, checking all requested properties, collecting exact purchase pages with displayed prices, and submitting a report.
sents.zh: 每个任务都要求找到合适的配置，核对所有要求的属性，收集显示价格的准确购买页面，并提交一份报告。

sents.en: The evaluation distinguishes a filled answer field from a verified claim, so broad product coverage alone is insufficient for a high score and a fully supported report.

paragraphs.en: The eight selected cases cover seven tasks and five model labels. I1–I5 illustrate increasing verification credit, while F1–F3 illustrate declining scores, unsupported coverage, incomplete answers, or no score improvement. Each case has three attempts, denoted R1–R3. The largest displayed score is 27.50%, so an improvement remains partial instead of indicating completion of the task. The I labels retain source cases S1–S5 and mark improvement rather than success.
paragraphs.zh: 这八个精选案例涵盖七项任务和五个模型标签。 I1–I5 展示了验证得分的逐步提升，而 F1–F3 则展示了分数下降、缺乏依据的覆盖、答案不完整或分数无提升的情况。 每个案例包含三次尝试，记为 R1–R3。 所显示的最高分数为 27.50%，因此提升仍然是局部的，并不表示任务已完成。 I 标签保留了源案例 S1–S5，并表示的是改进而非成功。

sents.en: The eight selected cases cover seven tasks and five model labels.
sents.zh: 这八个精选案例涵盖七项任务和五个模型标签。

sents.en: I1–I5 illustrate increasing verification credit, while F1–F3 illustrate declining scores, unsupported coverage, incomplete answers, or no score improvement.
sents.zh: I1–I5 展示了验证得分的逐步提升，而 F1–F3 则展示了分数下降、缺乏依据的覆盖、答案不完整或分数无提升的情况。

sents.zh: 每个案例包含三次尝试，记为 R1–R3。

sents.en: The I labels retain source cases S1–S5 and mark improvement rather than success.
sents.zh: I 标签保留了源案例 S1–S5，并表示的是改进而非成功。

paragraphs.en: Each task requests 30 product/configuration entries and three purchase pages per entry. One compound attribute item is scored per entry, plus one item per purchase page:
paragraphs.zh: 每个任务请求30条产品/配置条目，且每条对应三个购买页面。 每条评分一个复合属性项，外加每个购买页面各一个评分项：

sents.en: Each task requests 30 product/configuration entries and three purchase pages per entry.
sents.zh: 每个任务请求30条产品/配置条目，且每条对应三个购买页面。

sents.en: One compound attribute item is scored per entry, plus one item per purchase page:
sents.zh: 每条评分一个复合属性项，外加每个购买页面各一个评分项：

paragraphs.en: Submission coverage and local evidence-save acceptance are separate diagnostics. A credited page does not establish that its product satisfies every hardware constraint.
paragraphs.zh: 提交覆盖范围与本地证据保存的接受状态是两类不同的诊断。 获得计入的页面并不能证明其产品满足所有硬件约束。

sents.en: Submission coverage and local evidence-save acceptance are separate diagnostics.
sents.zh: 提交覆盖范围与本地证据保存的接受状态是两类不同的诊断。
